image_description: A rustic, semi-outdoor industrial scene featuring a large, weathered concrete or plaster building with a high roof. In the foreground, there is a wooden post supporting a green metal arm (possibly part of a crane or conveyor). The ground is dirt and debris-strewn. Inside the open-sided structure, heavy machinery, logs, and processed timber are visible. A yellow piece of equipment (likely a small excavator or loader) is seen in the background right. Stacks of wood and raw logs are present.
